title: Biallelic ELOC-Inactivated Renal Cell Carcinoma: Molecular Features Supporting Classification as a Distinct Entity.
authors: Batavia, Aashil A; Rutishauser, Dorothea; Sobottka, Bettina; Schraml, Peter; Beerenwinkel, Niko; Moch, Holger
journal: Modern pathology : an official journal of the United States and Canadian Academy of Pathology, Inc
one_liner_zh: 该文通过测序和HADDOCK分子对接研究ELOC失活肾细胞癌的分子特征，涉及ELOC-VHL蛋白互作建模，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Approximately 70% of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is characterized by the biallelic inactivation of von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) on chromosome 3p. ELOC-mutated (Elongin C-mutated) renal cell carcinoma containing biallelic ELOC inactivations with chromosome 8q deletions is considered a novel subtype of renal cancer possessing a morphologic overlap with ccRCC, renal cell carcinoma (RCC) with fibromyomatous stroma exhibiting Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (TSC)/mammalian Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) mutations, and clear cell papillary tumor. However, the frequency and consequences of ELOC alterations in wild-type VHL and mutated VHL RCC are unclear. In this study, we characterize 123 renal tumors with clear cell morphology and known VHL mutation status to assess the morphologic and molecular consequences of ELOC inactivation. Using OncoScan and whole-exome sequencing, we identify 18 ELOC-deleted RCCs, 3 of which contain ELOC mutations resulting in the biallelic inactivation of ELOC. Biallelic ELOC and biallelic VHL aberrations were mutually exclusive; however, 2 ELOC-mutated RCCs showed monoallelic VHL alterations. Furthermore, no mutations in TSC1, TSC2, or mTOR were identified in ELOC-mutated RCC with biallelic ELOC inactivation. Using High Ambiguity Driven biomolecular DOCKing, we report a novel ELOC variant containing a duplication event disrupting ELOC-VHL interaction alongside the frequently seen Y79C alteration. Using hyper reaction monitoring mass spectrometry, we show RCCs with biallelic ELOC alterations have significantly reduced ELOC expression but similar carbonic anhydrase 9 and vascular endothelial growth factor A expression compared with classical ccRCC with biallelic VHL inactivation. The absence of biallelic VHL and TSC1, TSC2, or mTOR inactivation in RCC with biallelic ELOC inactivation (ELOC mutation in combination with ELOC deletions on chromosome 8q) supports the notion of a novel, molecularly defined tumor entity.
abstract_zh: 约70%的透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）以染色体3p上von Hippel-Lindau（VHL）的双等位基因失活为特征。含有双等位基因ELOC失活及染色体8q缺失的ELOC突变（Elongin C突变）肾细胞癌，被认为是一种新型肾癌亚型，其形态与ccRCC、具有纤维肌瘤性间质的肾细胞癌（RCC）（表现为结节性硬化症（TSC）/哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白（mTOR）突变）以及透明细胞乳头状肿瘤存在重叠。然而，在野生型VHL和突变型VHL的RCC中，ELOC改变的频率及其后果尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们对123例具有透明细胞形态且已知VHL突变状态的肾肿瘤进行了表征，以评估ELOC失活的形态学和分子后果。利用OncoScan和全外显子组测序，我们鉴定出18例ELOC缺失的RCC，其中3例含有ELOC突变，导致ELOC双等位基因失活。双等位基因ELOC和双等位基因VHL异常是互斥的；然而，2例ELOC突变的RCC显示单等位基因VHL改变。此外，在具有双等位基因ELOC失活的ELOC突变RCC中，未检测到TSC1、TSC2或mTOR的突变。使用高模糊度驱动的生物分子对接（High Ambiguity Driven biomolecular DOCKing），我们报告了一种新型ELOC变体，该变体包含一个重复事件，破坏ELOC-VHL相互作用，同时伴有常见的Y79C改变。通过超反应监测质谱法，我们显示，与具有双等位基因VHL失活的经典ccRCC相比，具有双等位基因ELOC改变的RCC中ELOC表达显著降低，但碳酸酐酶9和血管内皮生长因子A表达相似。在具有双等位基因ELOC失活的RCC中（ELOC突变与染色体8q上ELOC缺失相结合），缺乏双等位基因VHL和TSC1、TSC2或mTOR失活，支持了一种新型、分子定义肿瘤实体的概念。
